ethics.title: Strict Geodata Protection
ethics.warning: To protect free-roaming animals from poisoning or unauthorized culling, raw coordinates are NEVER publicly disclosed.
points: Exact GPS coordinates are restricted exclusively to certified scientific researchers (Pasteur Institute / National Veterinary Services).
Public maps display only anonymized, aggregated 1 km² density cells.
You can export or delete your account and all contributed data at any time.
ethics.consent_checkbox: I accept the ethical charter, privacy policy, and scientific data-sharing protocol

privacy.footer: Deleting your account keeps your observations for science, stripped of your identity: they stay at 1 km precision, and precise locations, GPS tracks, notes and photos are removed permanently.
privacy.export_sub: Everything the server holds about you, as JSON
privacy.delete_sub: Erase your identity, photos and precise locations
privacy.delete_confirm_body: Your profile, photos, precise locations and GPS tracks will be permanently erased. Anonymous 1 km observations remain in the scientific dataset. This cannot be undone.
privacy.delete_done_body: Your personal data has been erased.
